scenario: [LEXP.3.7.2]: `bit_count` is a member of `Int` only. On the Float slot `s.v`, `.bit_count` names no member of `Float`, so the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER ([LGRA.9.6.2]). The receiver is a value, not the fact binding, so this is not an unknown-slot error either.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.v.bit_count > 0
->
    log info "x"
